children.note: Lean file: lean/Containers/Containers/CompLeftAdjoint.lean, wired into Containers.lean root; `lake build` green 2026-08-30, sorry-free, zero warnings. `#print axioms` = [Quot.sound] ONLY (no sorryAx, no Classical.choice, no propext) on all six declarations: leftAdjMap_id, leftAdjMap_comp, triangle_leftAdj, triangle_seq, adjUntranspose_adjTranspose, adjTranspose_adjUntranspose. VARIANCE CERTIFIED (the point of formalising): a ContainerMorphism is forward on shapes and BACKWARD on positions, so F_q's action on morphisms is Ext.map (phi.onPos rho) : [[q]](U'(h rho)) -> [[q]](U rho) -- running [[q]] over the backward leg. Pushing [[q]] forward, which the shape-level formula F_q(R,U)=(R, rho|->[[q]](U_rho)) invites, does not typecheck at all; the Yoneda argument of section 4.3 hides this. Every law is `ContainerMorphism.ext' rfl (fun _ _ => rfl)`: shapes definitionally equal, positions pointwise definitional, NO transport -- the fibres on both sides of each triangle agree on the nose. Unit = <rho, fun w => w.1> / eval `z.1.2 z.2`; counit = fst on shapes / `fun a => <sc.2 a, fun z => <a, z>>` (coproduct injection) -- verbatim the section 4.4 formulas. NEGATIVE CONTROL run: perturbing the counit's backward map to inject at a fixed position a_0 makes triangle_seq FAIL (type mismatch on the position leg, shape leg still rfl), so the triangles are not vacuously rfl-able and ext's position hypothesis does real work. `(-)<|q` is `Container.seq p q` from Sequential.lean (G outside), matching the informal convention; whiskerRight from Monoidal.lean supplies `eps <| q`. NB LEAN.md pointed at Composition.lean, which is orphaned (clashes with Sequential over Container.I); Sequential/Monoidal are the live modules. Does NOT formalise: naturality of F_q in q (flagged unchecked in Theorem B), the Fam(Vec^op) version, or the right adjoint (which does not exist for |T|>=2).

children.note: Lean file: lean/Containers/Containers/CompLeftAdjoint.lean (extends the lean-adjunction node in the same module); `lake build` green 2026-08-30, sorry-free, zero warnings, all seven new declarations landed on the FIRST build. GAP CLOSED: the earlier lean-adjunction node proved the two triangles and both round trips, but adjUnit/adjCounit were only FAMILIES of morphisms -- their naturality was never stated, so 'F_q -| L_q' was not yet certified as an adjunction of functors. Now added: whiskerRight_id, whiskerRight_comp (L_q functorial, from seq2_id/seq2_comp), adjUnit_naturality, adjCounit_naturality, adjTranspose_naturality_right, adjTranspose_naturality_left, adjCounitPerturbed_naturality. `#print axioms`: whiskerRight_id and whiskerRight_comp depend on NO axioms; the other five are [Quot.sound] ONLY (no sorryAx, no Classical.choice, no propext). Together with leftAdjMap_id/leftAdjMap_comp and the two triangles this is the complete definition of an adjunction. TWO NEGATIVE CONTROLS, and they give a genuine finding. Control 1 (compiles, recorded as the theorem adjCounitPerturbed_naturality): for qBool = (one shape, two positions), the perturbed counit eps'_p a = <c a, fun z => <a, !z>> -- which the PREVIOUS cycle showed BREAKS triangle_seq -- still satisfies the naturality square ON THE NOSE. So naturality and the triangle identities are INDEPENDENT probes of the counit: neither implies the other, and certifying one leaves the other free to be wrong. Control 2 (a failure, so recorded in the module docstring in prose): post-composing the unit square with the nontrivial automorphism <w,z> |-> <w,!z> of F_q r <| qBool makes adjUnit_naturality FAIL -- and it fails on the POSITION leg while the shape leg still discharges by rfl. Hence the naturality squares are non-vacuous, and, exactly as for the triangles, their content sits in the POSITIONS: a shape-level argument certifies a wrong unit just as happily. This is the second independent confirmation of the shape-leg-is-under-determined warning to carry into any Fam(C^op) version. STILL NOT formalised: naturality of F_q in the parameter q (contravariant, since positions run backwards), the Fam(Vec^op) version (open), and the right adjoint (does not exist for |T|>=2).
